chapter.verse: Sanggamte aw, Jew mite' ading lungsim sungpan ka deihsak thu leh Pasian' kiangah ka ngetsak thu ahihleh amaute hotkhiat a ngah nading uh ahi hi.
A hang pen amaute Pasian' thu ah lawpna lianpi a neih lam uh telin teci ka pang hi. Ahi zongin tua a lawpna uh pen thutheihna cingtaak tawh hilo hi.
Pasian' dikna thu theikha lo-in amau' dikna tungah kingakh sawm uh ahih manin Pasian' dikna nuai-ah niamlut lo uh hi.
A hang pen a umte khempeuh' ading diktatna thu a om theih nadingin Khris pen thukhun kicinna ahi hi.
Moses in thukhun bulphuh dikna thu na gelhkhia a, “Hih thute a zui mi pen hih thute tawh kituakin nungta ding hi,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin upna tunga kinga dikna thu in a genin ah, “Na lungsim sung uhah, ‘Vantung ah kua va kahto ding hiam?’ (kua in Khris hong paipihsuk ding) ci kei unla,
‘Leihawmpi ah kua va tuaksuk ding hiam?’ (kua in misite' lakpan Khris hong paipihto ding) zong ci kei un,” ci hi.
Bang cizaw ahi hiam? “Pasian' thu tawh na kinai uh hi; na kam sung uh leh na lungsim sung uhah om hi,” ci hi. (Pasian' thu cih ciangin ka tangkokhiat uh upna thu ahi hi).
Banghanghiam cihleh Jesu pen Topa hi, ci-in na kam uh tawh pulakin Pasian in misite' lakpan amah thokiksak hi, ci-in na lungsim sung uhah na up uhleh hotkhiat na ngah ding uh hi.
A hang pen lungsim sunga upna tawh diksakna kingah a, kam panin pulakna tawh hotkhiatna kingah hi.
Pasian' Laibu in, “Amah a um khempeuh maizumna tuakkha lo ding hi,” ci hi.
A hang pen Jew mi leh Greek mi kikal tuamdangna om lo a, tua Topa mah pen ama' kianga thungente khempeuh' tungah thupha tampitak a pia, vekpi' Topa ahi hi.
Tua hi a, “Topa' min tawh thungen khempeuh hotkhiat ngah ding uh hi.”
Tua ahihleh amaute in a up loh khat' tungah bangci-in thungen thei ding uh hiam? A zak ngeiloh uh mi khat bangci up ding uh hiam? A tangko kuamah om keileh a thu bangci zak ding uh hiam?
Kisawlkhia lo pi-in kua in thu bangci tangko theih ding hiam? Tua hang mahin, “Lungdamna Thu a tangko mite' khe bangzahin etlawm!” ci-in kigelh hi.
Ahih hangin mi khempeuh in Lungdamna Thu ngai kimlo uh hi. Tua hangin Isaiah in, “Topa aw, ka thugen uh kua in um ahi hiam?” na ci hi.
Tua hi a, upna pen zakna pan hong pai-in zakna pen Khris thu kigenna pan hong pai hi.
Ahihleh mite in za nailo uh hiam, ci-in kong dong hi. Za khin lua uh hi. A hang pen: “Amaute' awging leitung bup ah kuankhia a, amau' thugente leimong dong ah kizel hi.”

Ahihleh Israel mite in tel lo uh hiam, ci-in kong dong hi. A masa-in Moses in hih na ci hi: “Minam kician ahilote nangawn a haza dingin kong bawl ding a, a haitat minam khat' tungah a hehsuak dingin kong tawng ding hi.”
Isaiah in zong hangtakin hih na ci hi: “Kei hong zong lo mite in kei hong mu khinta uh a, Kei hong kan lo mite' kiangah keimahmah ka kilak hi.”
Himah taleh Israel mite' thu hih bangin na ci hi: “A thumanglo, thu a sel thei mite lamah sun thapai ka khutte zakin ka ngak hi.”
